_comment: The RL job (train.py), on top of the catalog's Qwen3-0.6B training and inference files: prime-rl's deployment of one training GPU and one sampling GPU, its 2048-token window, and its AdamW (lr 3e-6, weight decay 0.01, betas 0.9/0.999). The DeepSpeed batch fields are dropped for the single GPU, and bf16 stays enabled (fp32 master weights; see the README). The SFT warmup uses sft_overrides.json.
